result:
If I could change one thing about the world, it would be to make sure every person has the basic security and dignity they need to thrive. No one should have to worry about where they'll sleep, whether they can feed their children, or if they'll be denied medical care. It's that foundation of stability that allows everything else to grow—creativity, community, curiosity, connection.

Not because it would solve everything, but because so much of the suffering in the world stems from that scarcity, and so much of the good in people flourishes once they have a floor beneath their feet.

What about you?
